Pharrukhabad ki mashhur chat papri ghar par banaen. ye krispi papri chat chay ke sath bhi khaee ja sakti hai aur speshal chat bana kar bhi . Farrukhabad Famous Papdi Chaat Recipe men sikhaya hai kam oyal vali krispi papri aur parphekt chat kaise banayen.
Aalu papri, pharrukhabadi papri, strit stail chat – sab kuchh ek vidiyo men.
kam tel men kurkuri papri
aalu, chana aur khas masale vali svadisht chat
chay ke sath ya dahi ke sath – donon tarike
Yah paranprik yupi strit phud (UP Street Food) resipi pasand aae, to vidiyo ko laik aur sheyar karna na bhulen!
